summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into victory at Las Vegas, navigating 34 lead changes across an extraordinary race that saw the Red Bull driver emerge as the decisive operator amid constant turmoil. Ferrari's championship contenders Hamilton and Leclerc collided during the race, triggering yet another internal inquest at Maranello over their ability to race cleanly together. With two rounds remaining, Verstappen's win tightens the battle behind championship leader Antonelli, who faced a qualifying penalty that cost him the starting position despite setting the fastest time.
